rationale: Era is building Edge's applied AI infrastructure focused on edge inference and open-source composability, while Jiale's expertise spans ML infrastructure, distributed training systems, and scalable ML platforms at Meta—making them natural collaborators on the systems and infrastructure layer of on-device AI. Both are in San Francisco and deeply embedded in the frontier AI community; Jiale's low-level systems background (Cloudflare, Uber AI Labs) and current work on deep learning infrastructure directly complements Era's vision for production-grade, sovereign AI stacks.
intro_message: Era Qian, meet Jiale Zhi — you're both tackling ML infrastructure from different angles (Era on edge intelligence and open-source stacks, Jiale on distributed training and scalable platforms at Meta), and your backgrounds in systems-level work could unlock some interesting collaboration.
